title: Returned-Payment Reserve on Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Discretionary Reinstatements
content:
A discretionary reinstatement of a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract carries a returned-payment reserve, counting the payments returned by the customer's bank after the same calendar day twelve months before the statement date, up to and including the statement date.

| Payments returned in the counted twelve months | Returned-payment reserve |
|---|---|
| Two or more | one monthly installment |
| Exactly one | 25 percent (the returned-payment reserve share) of one monthly installment, rounded to the cent |
| None | nothing |
| Any — a reinstatement the state reinstatement period grants | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases (statement date 20 March of a year, monthly installment $398.80)

- One payment returned on 21 March of the year before: counted; reserve 25 percent of $398.80, that is $99.70.
- One payment returned on 20 March of the year before: not counted (not after the same calendar day twelve months back); with no other return, nothing.
- Three payments returned in the counted months: $398.80.
